limitations: Retained source edition, not a live feed or a claim of the latest available release.
Country/territory coverage and source flags vary. Missing observations are not zero; no interpolation or carry-forward is performed.
Commodity groups and their component items are separate source series and must not be added together.
Only an exact frozen UN M49 to ISO3 crosswalk is used. Composite China, regional aggregates and unmatched source entities remain in a separate table.
Country averages do not locate farms, households or owners; no ownership or causal inference is supplied.
Production quantity is not yield, harvested area, animal stocks or a food-balance availability estimate. Egg mass and egg counts remain separate.
The bundled current map boundaries illustrate source-country accounts; they do not reconstruct historical borders or reallocate former countries to successors.
Historical extension of the same retained source edition; every offered period is an actual original source row, without interpolation.
Historical source countries, aggregates, composite China and other areas not in the exact retained M49 crosswalk are preserved in a separate table, not reassigned to present-day countries.
series.reporting_period: FAOSTAT reporting year; national crop-year conventions may differ
series.history_selection: All actual retained source years for the exact selected item, element and native unit
